test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"securing"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To **secure** something is **to ensure that it is shielded from a threat or danger**.

 
 
• ***Example:** They installed a cctv camera to **secure** their house.*
 
 
 
• The poor arab secured **an audience** and gave him the **water bottle made of leather**.
 
• Therefore, "**securing"** is the perfect word to use in the given blank.

The correct sentence will be **"After securing__ an audience with the Caliph there".**
